name: create_page
description: This tool belongs to the Notion API, which provides workspace platform for notes, documents, wikis, and project management with collaborative editing and database functionality. Tool description: Create a new page in a workspace, optionally nested under an existing parent page.

workspace_id.description: The ID of the workspace to create the page in.

content.description: Body content of the page in markdown format. Defaults to empty string.

parent_page_id.description: ID of the parent page to nest this page under. If null, the page is created at the top level of the workspace.

properties.description: Dict[str, Any]: page_id (str), workspace_id (str), title (str), content (str), parent_page_id (str | None), created_at (str), updated_at (str), created_by (str), url (str).

name: get_page
description: This tool belongs to the Notion API, which provides workspace platform for notes, documents, wikis, and project management with collaborative editing and database functionality. Tool description: Retrieve the full details of a page by its ID.

page_id.description: The unique identifier of the page to retrieve.

properties.description: Dict[str, Any]: page_id (str), workspace_id (str), title (str), content (str), parent_page_id (str | None), created_at (str), updated_at (str), created_by (str), last_edited_by (str), url (str), shared_with (List[Dict]).

name: list_pages
description: This tool belongs to the Notion API, which provides workspace platform for notes, documents, wikis, and project management with collaborative editing and database functionality. Tool description: List all pages in a given workspace.

workspace_id.description: The ID of the workspace whose pages to list.

properties.description: List[Dict[str, Any]]: Page summary objects, each with fields: page_id (str), title (str), parent_page_id (str | None), created_at (str), updated_at (str), created_by (str).

name: update_page
description: This tool belongs to the Notion API, which provides workspace platform for notes, documents, wikis, and project management with collaborative editing and database functionality. Tool description: Update the title and/or content of an existing page.

page_id.description: The unique identifier of the page to update.

title.description: New title for the page. If null, the title remains unchanged.

content.description: New body content for the page in markdown format. If null, the content remains unchanged.

properties.description: Dict[str, Any]: page_id (str), title (str), content (str), updated_at (str), last_edited_by (str).

name: delete_page
description: This tool belongs to the Notion API, which provides workspace platform for notes, documents, wikis, and project management with collaborative editing and database functionality. Tool description: Delete a page by its ID. This moves the page to trash.

page_id.description: The unique identifier of the page to delete.

name: search_workspace
description: This tool belongs to the Notion API, which provides workspace platform for notes, documents, wikis, and project management with collaborative editing and database functionality. Tool description: Search for pages and databases within a workspace by keyword query.

workspace_id.description: The ID of the workspace to search in.

properties.description: List[Dict[str, Any]]: Search result objects, each with fields: object_type (str "page" or "database"), object_id (str), title (str), snippet (str), updated_at (str), url (str).

name: create_database
description: This tool belongs to the Notion API, which provides workspace platform for notes, documents, wikis, and project management with collaborative editing and database functionality. Tool description: Create a new database (structured table) in a workspace with defined property columns.

workspace_id.description: The ID of the workspace to create the database in.

properties.description: Dictionary mapping property names to their types (e.g. {"Status": "select", "Due Date": "date", "Assignee": "person"}).
Dict[str, Any]: database_id (str), workspace_id (str), title (str), properties (Dict[str, str]), created_at (str), url (str).

name: get_database
description: This tool belongs to the Notion API, which provides workspace platform for notes, documents, wikis, and project management with collaborative editing and database functionality. Tool description: Retrieve details and schema of a database by its ID.

database_id.description: The unique identifier of the database to retrieve.

properties.description: Dict[str, Any]: database_id (str), workspace_id (str), title (str), properties (Dict[str, str]), entry_count (int), created_at (str), updated_at (str), url (str).

name: add_database_entry
description: This tool belongs to the Notion API, which provides workspace platform for notes, documents, wikis, and project management with collaborative editing and database functionality. Tool description: Add a new row/entry to an existing database.

database_id.description: The ID of the database to add the entry to.

fields.description: Dictionary mapping property names to their values (e.g. {"Name": "Task A", "Status": "In Progress", "Due Date": "2026-04-01"}).

properties.description: Dict[str, Any]: entry_id (str), database_id (str), fields (Dict[str, Any]), created_at (str), url (str).

name: list_workspaces
description: This tool belongs to the Notion API, which provides workspace platform for notes, documents, wikis, and project management with collaborative editing and database functionality. Tool description: List all workspaces accessible to the current user.

properties.description: List[Dict[str, Any]]: Workspace objects, each with fields: workspace_id (str), name (str), icon (str | None), member_count (int), plan (str).

name: share_page
description: This tool belongs to the Notion API, which provides workspace platform for notes, documents, wikis, and project management with collaborative editing and database functionality. Tool description: Share a page with another user by email, granting them a specified permission level.

page_id.description: The ID of the page to share.

email.description: Email address of the person to share with.

permission.description: Permission level to grant -- "view", "comment", or "edit". Defaults to "view".

properties.description: Dict[str, Any]: page_id (str), shared_with_email (str), permission (str), shared_at (str).

name: get_user_profile
description: This tool belongs to the Notion API, which provides workspace platform for notes, documents, wikis, and project management with collaborative editing and database functionality. Tool description: Retrieve the current user's Notion profile.

properties.description: Dict[str, Any]: user_id (str), name (str), email (str), avatar_url (str | None), workspaces (List[str]), plan (str).
